title: qa(checklist): platform-core.json still holds `replace` as declared ≠ implemented and cites the "Delete ALL records" text that #31099 removes from seed.zod.ts
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eHDXrsKgGAUHq956U

Filing gate: ① defect in a shipped QA instrument (a checklist row whose stated posture goes false when PR #31135 lands), from the contract review of PR #31135 (card #31099), ③ boundary flag 2. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
Reader: the seat that owns `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` — `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, next PR that touches it.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "platform-core.json replace \"Delete ALL\"" → 10 hits, none about this row (#31099 is the source card; #24579 is an older anchor re-point).
reach: every QA run that reads the platform-core area: the row's clause and its source citation are what the runner checks against.
class: c · type: Bug

## What is wrong

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` ~L3111 states "EXPECTED POSTURE (declared ≠ implemented): `replace` is documented 'Delete ALL records in object then insert (Dangerous)' but the implementation is bare insert", and ~L3141 cites `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts#SeedMode` for "replace's 'Delete ALL records … Dangerous' claim". PR #31135 rewrites that comment to what the loader does ("Insert every record, no match, deleting nothing: for a cache table the caller cleared"). Once it lands, declared = implemented and the citation names text the source no longer holds. The probe itself (~L3081, "F SURVIVES and G is inserted") stays valid.

## Owed

Re-word the row's expected posture to "declared = implemented: `replace` inserts and deletes nothing" and drop the stale quotation from the citation. Text only, no runner change. Do it after PR #31135 merges.

Related: #31099, PR #31135.
